reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: My Personal REVIEW OF NRI MEDICAL COLLEGE GUNTUR.

review_content.Placements: Almost 80% of students are placed in various hospitals after the course. The roles offered in this course are based on our rank in the PG exam. For example, it includes departments like gynecology, orthopedics, pediatrics, and surgery. Recruitment is students' choice, whether to join a big hospital or set up their own clinic.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are decent and good on the campus. Hostel rooms and food are better than I expected. Medical facilities are also available on our campus. A cricket ground, basketball, volleyball, and badminton court are present. After class timings, students can play any game they want. Indoor games like chess, carrom, and table tennis are also available on the campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: NRI Medical College review.

review_content.Placements: There are no placements for MBBS students here. However, we will get good PG seats, and many of our seniors have been placed even in INI CET USMLE and PLAB exams.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good. They have sports facilities and a sports fest every year. However, there is no Wi-Fi facility for students.
review_content.Faculty: The teachers at this college are extremely helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The curriculum is pretty good, and once we have done our internship, we are ready to go. There are 9 semesters, and they are pretty hard. The pass percentage is 50%, but if we try hard enough, we will get through it.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Our college provides helpful teachers, but the facilities are bad.

review_content.Placements: There are about 200 students in our batch, and every year almost 15 students will fail to pass the final exam. After passing, we need to perform house duties in the hospital. Mostly, girls take the long course, and the remaining will take general medicine or surgery courses. In today scenarios, most people wish to join the cardiology and radiology fields.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college provides huge classrooms. The library is well-built without any disturbances. The quality of the food served in the hostel mess is not much better. The college does not provide a Wi-Fi facility, but a network speed facility is available in our hostels. The canteen is available, and it is somewhat better than hostel mess.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: It is a very good place to build our career.

review_content.Placements: Most of the students from our course got placed. About 80% of the students get good PG admissions. None of the companies visits here to recruit students from our course. Roles will be offered to students according to their capability. Internships are offered to all the students who will be passed in their final examinations.
review_content.Infrastructure: Sports and games are well encouraged here. There is good equipment for practical studies, and the campus has good furniture. I love the way the library is arranged, and it contains a peaceful environment. The anatomy is the most beautiful thing, and the staff members are excellent.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Review of NRI Medical College.

review_content.Placements: Placements depend on the students. Students can be highly benefited based on their interest.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college provides a good outpatient ward with good facilities in the hospital. The hostel is maintained better, and the mess is also better. Classrooms are huge, spacious and well-equipped with centralised air-conditioning and PowerPoint presentations. Facilities are good here, and there is a cafe in our college. A canteen is available in the hospital, and it is better. There are 2 basketball courts, separate badminton courts for boys and girls, throwball, ball badminton, football and cricket. There is a huge air-conditioned library. There is a good garden.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with college. It is the best medical college in Andhra Pradesh.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 50% of the students got placed. The fee varies according to the standard of students. For A-CAT, it is Rs. 10,000 per year, for B-CAT, it is 12 lacs per year, and for C-CAT, it is Rs. 30,000 per year. Almost 50% of the students got an internship from our course. MBBS and PG diploma courses are offered in our college.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has excellent classrooms with air-conditioners. Food in the canteen is above-average. Medical facilities are top-notch with excellent infrastructure. Sports and games meet is conducted once in every year with almost facilities, and we can enjoy a lot.

reviews.review_heading: My Personal REVIEW OF NRI MEDICAL COLLEGE GUNTUR.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are decent and good on the campus. Hostel rooms and food are better than I expected. Medical facilities are also available on our campus. Indoor games like chess, carrom, and table tennis are also available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: NRI Medical College review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. They have sports facilities and a sports fest every year. However, there is no Wi-Fi facility for students.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides helpful teachers, but the facilities are bad.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides huge classrooms. The library is well-built without any disturbances. The quality of the food served in the hostel mess is not much better. The college does not provide a Wi-Fi facility, but a network speed facility is available in our hostels. The canteen is available, and it is somewhat better than hostel mess.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good place to build our career.
reviews.review_text: Sports and games are well encouraged here. There is good equipment for practical studies, and the campus has good furniture. I love the way the library is arranged, and it contains a peaceful environment. The anatomy is the most beautiful thing, and the staff members are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NRI Medical College.

A canteen is available in the hospital, and it is better. There are 2 basketball courts, separate badminton courts for boys and girls, throwball, ball badminton, football and cricket...

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with college. It is the best medical college in Andhra Pradesh.
reviews.review_text: Our college has excellent classrooms with air-conditioners. Food in the canteen is above-average. Medical facilities are top-notch with excellent infrastructure. Sports and games meet is conducted once in every year with almost facilities, and we can enjoy a lot.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good education and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: I am studying in a private college. It has good infrastructure, laboratory facilities, classrooms with air-conditioning and a library with many books. There is no Wi-Fi facility. However, the hostel rooms are good, but the food served is not good. Our college has a cafeteria, which has a huge range of food items, but it is not less than a typical restaurant. Medical checkups, tests and other diagnostic tests are free for the students who are studying here. Our college has a good playground, alon...

reviews.review_heading: The college has a good environment for learning.
reviews.review_text: Our college has different buildings in one compound, 1 was college, and other was a hospital and remaining including a hostel for both boys and girls. The warehouse is also available, and a large playground for games. We have a library, labs and seminar halls in our college. We have auditorium and galleries for conducting classes for students.

reviews.review_heading: Really good for academics and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and libraries were good, neat, and clean, with advanced technology. Girls' hostel was better than the boys' hostel. Hygiene was very good. The food in the cafe was good. Sports facilities, Sports Day, and cultural activities like Annual Day were really fun. There were philanthropic ventures, research opportunities, and conferences as well. The Cancer block was very good and advanced, by far, one of the best in South India.

reviews.review_heading: Good to choose this college will have great experience with the clinical knowledge .

Coming to sports the campus it self has a huge play area and basketball court it would great opportunity to build the sports career too .

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college for teaching and clinical exposure.

Wi_Fi is not available in our library. Classrooms are big and seating is available for all. Medical facilities are avaialble for students.

highlights.summary:
The NEET MDS 2026 application process has commenced for Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences admission to the MDS course, with Mar 30, 2026, being the last date to register. Also, the NEET MDS exam 2026 is going to be held on May 2, 2026.

A few more updates are given below:

placements.overview: Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences, is located in Bhubaneswar, Orissa. Established in 2007, it is a private institute approved by DCI. Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences provides 11 UG, PG and Doctorate courses in several specialisations. Theses programmes are offered in Full Time mode. BDS, MDS and Ph.D. are some of the courses offered at Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences. Some of the stream in which these courses are offered include Medicine & Health Sciences. The total fee at Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences ranges between INR 3,00,000 to 2,60,00,000. Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences has a student intake of 121 for all the courses. Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences offers all the infrastructural facilities to students.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Director doesn't do his job. He is not at all cooperative.

review_content.Placements: In medical colleges, placement is 100%. The highest monthly salary is above Rs. 1 lac initially, but later, one can earn unlimited income. No companies come to recruit. Every student does an internship in our college. Top roles depend on the job the student is doing.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure: everything is there but not very well-renovated. The hostel is good to stay in. The mess food is not up to the mark. But the only problem is that the room's windows are only for one person; the other person can't get any access to the windows. I need additional supplements to survive. The food is dipped in oil. Vegetables are fried to a crisp.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2016
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best college in our state for our course.

review_content.Placements: The college doesn't provide any placements. However, we can join the other colleges of the same rank after the course. But if we look into placements provided by the college, then it is disappointing as they don't have such provision for this course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. The library and classrooms are well-equipped. The campus provides everything. Gymnasium and swimming pool are excellent. Hospital is extremely functional and has great emergency handling capacities. The campus is enabled with Wi-Fi.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: An insight into KALINGA INSTITUTE OF DENTAL Science.

review_content.Placements: The BDS course doesn't offer placements like engineering, MBA and other courses. However, they provide paid rotatory internship (which is a part of the 5 year course programme). The stipend is amongst the highest offered in indian dental colleges. Also the patient flow is satisfactory.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are 9 well-equipped and fully functional departments. Others: 6 air conditioned lecture theatres, Phantom lab (preclinical conservative lab), Preclinical prosthodontics lab and an air conditioned auditorium with a seating capacity of 300 approximately. Air conditioned library is also there.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Kalinga institute of dental science is a heaven for students who want both academics and social life

review_content.Placements: Medical and dental colleges are professional colleges so there is no tension of placement. Placement is good. Your future is settled. You can work with senior doctors after completing internship. You can prepare for MS side by side. After completing BDS you can work for any hospital or open clinic. You can start preparing for MS if you want to get into teaching line and become a professor. BDS degree has many scopes. Jobs just after completing BDS will carry packages of approximately 10 to 15 thousands per month. It will increase as your experience increases.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: The campus is good. Faculty members are good. Good infrastructure. Moderate patient flow.

review_content.Placements: There is no placement as it's a dental college, and since it is a part of medical college, according to DCI, it has the internship programme for 1 year. Since it's a medical college, placements are not currently present. I do hope that the medical boards someday would put placements in medical and dental colleges.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The college has good equipment and offers a good background to deal with a patient, but lacks in providing materials required while doing work with a patient. Otherwise, the infrastructure is overall good with a moderate patient flow in the hospital.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with its faculty, superb infrastructure and facilities.

review_content.Placements: There will be a superb placement here, according to your result as it deals with the medical subjects. The salary for the internship is Rs. 10,000 per month. Also, everyone got the internship in this college itself as one has to do the internship here only and the stipend was Rs. 10,000, which is very useful and I love it a lot.
review_content.Infrastructure: It has the best infrastructure, and I loved to go to the classes. It has a Wi-Fi available for each student individually. They also have labs for each ward. It also has AC lecture theatres and an AC library. It also has sports room. The food in the canteen is also great. Also, the hostel rooms are good and are double seated. I love it.

individual_reviews.title: Director doesn't do his job. He is not at all cooperative.

content.Placements: In medical colleges, placement is 100%. The highest monthly salary is above Rs. 1 lac initially, but later, one can earn unlimited income. No companies come to recruit. Every student does an internship in our college. Top roles depend on the job the student is doing.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure: everything is there but not very well-renovated. The hostel is good to stay in. The mess food is not up to the mark. But the only problem is that the room's windows are only for one person; the other person can't get any access to the windows. I need additional supplements to survive. The food is dipped in oil. Vegetables are fried to a crisp.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college in our state for our course.

content.Placements: The college doesn't provide any placements. However, we can join the other colleges of the same rank after the course. But if we look into placements provided by the college, then it is disappointing as they don't have such provision for this course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. The library and classrooms are well-equipped. The campus provides everything. Gymnasium and swimming pool are excellent. Hospital is extremely functional and has great emergency handling capacities. The campus is enabled with Wi-Fi.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: An insight into KALINGA INSTITUTE OF DENTAL Science.

content.Placements: The BDS course doesn't offer placements like engineering, MBA and other courses. However, they provide paid rotatory internship (which is a part of the 5 year course programme). The stipend is amongst the highest offered in indian dental colleges. Also the patient flow is satisfactory.
content.Infrastructure: There are 9 well-equipped and fully functional departments. Others: 6 air conditioned lecture theatres, Phantom lab (preclinical conservative lab), Preclinical prosthodontics lab and an air conditioned auditorium with a seating capacity of 300 approximately. Air conditioned library is also there.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Kalinga institute of dental science is a heaven for students who want both academics and social life

content.Placements: Medical and dental colleges are professional colleges so there is no tension of placement. Placement is good. Your future is settled. You can work with senior doctors after completing internship. You can prepare for MS side by side. After completing BDS you can work for any hospital or open clinic. You can start preparing for MS if you want to get into teaching line and become a professor. BDS degree has many scopes. Jobs just after completing BDS will carry packages of approximately 10 to 15 thousands per month. It will increase as your experience increases.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: The campus is good. Faculty members are good. Good infrastructure. Moderate patient flow.

content.Placements: There is no placement as it's a dental college, and since it is a part of medical college, according to DCI, it has the internship programme for 1 year. Since it's a medical college, placements are not currently present. I do hope that the medical boards someday would put placements in medical and dental colleges.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. review_summary.college_name: Smt. B.K. Shah Medical Institute and Research Centre Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely amazing experience to date, from academics to extracurricular activities.

content.Placements: In my batch, there are 250 students currently pursuing MBBS. Since it is the medical field, we don't have recruiting companies. Instead, we get residency in hospitals. In our college, the highest payout is 1.5 LPA. Almost 99% of students get internships. The top role offered is MO (Medical Officer).
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is well-constructed, especially the reading rooms, lecture halls, practical labs, demo labs, student mentor counseling rooms, and hostels. The entire campus has Wi-Fi accessibility. The quality of the hostel is 9/10, food is 8/10, medical facilities are 9/10, and sports and games are 10/10.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Beautiful college with good infrastructure and sports facilities. Teaching quality is good.

content.Placements: After MBBS from our college, we can do internships from our college. After 1 year of internship, we can attempt the NEET PG examination. In the NEET PG examination, we get the respective residence according to marks and then we can further pursue MD.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is good but hostel may affect certain individuals. Mess is of Jain origin so hostel or mess doesn't allow non-vegetarian food. Hostel and mess quality are average but both hostel and mess combined cost around 1 Lakhs. Library facility, dissection hall, auditorium, and specimen hall are good. Beautiful sports grounds, lawn tennis, badminton, court table, tennis cricket ground, gymnasium, and swimming pool are available.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Microbiology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I would not recommend students to join this college.

content.Placements: Around 4 students got placed in this course. Placements are not provided in our course. You should search for a job after getting your degree. No top recruiting companies visit our college for recruitment.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Laboratories are better. The library is decent. There are no classrooms for the microbiology department. The food served in the mess is average. The food is expensive. The hostel fee is reasonable compared to the private college. Swimming pool is available on our campus.
content.Faculty: Teachers are not helpful. They are well-qualified and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is not relevant. Practical knowledge is not provided in the first year, but in the second year, there is no theoretical knowledge.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This college is good with a lot of skills and fun, and it is ragging-free.

content.Placements: There are 150 students in our batch, but currently, they have increased the seats to 250. Around 20-50 students opted for higher studies from government colleges, and the remaining students opted for private colleges. We are offered a great salary with a stipend of Rs.80,000 offered in PG.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is well-furnished with good. All facilities include air-conditioned classrooms and Wi-Fi all over the campus. The hostel food is also good like we can eat it. We have two canteens and all indoor and outdoor sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Review of Smt. B.K. Shah Medical Institute and Research Centre.

content.Placements: About 150 students take admission here every year. The fee is Rs. 15,95,500 per year. Internships can be done here. After the degree, most of the students are doing great jobs in great hospitals. Whenever you want to learn anything regarding any case in medical, you are welcomed by all PGs and faculty members.
content.Infrastructure: There is a great study environment with high library facilities. 24x7 Wi-Fi facility is available. There are good lighting hostel rooms with average mess facilities. However, you can buy your favourite food from stores near our mess as the mess here is similar to any other college's mess. However, you will get unlimited food, and there are no restrictions at all. It is the best thing ever.

JSS Academy of Higher Education & Research offers UG, PG, diploma, certificate, and PhD courses across Pharmacy, Dentistry, Life Sciences, Management Studies, Yoga, and others. BSc, BPharma, and MSc are the flagship courses offered at JSS Mysore.
JSS University offers a full-time, three-year BSc programme at the UG level. The BSc programmes offered at the university cover core courses in the areas of Biotechnology, Microbiology, Psychology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Psychology, Environmental Sciences, and others. The MSc programme offered by the JSS College Mysore is a two-year programme. individual_reviews.course: M.Pharma. in Regulatory Affairs - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: M.Pharm in Regulatory Affairs at JSS College of Pharmacy.

content.Placements: Macleods Pharmaceuticals, Intas Pharmaceuticals, and Apollo Pharmacies Limited were the leading organizations that hired M.Pharm graduates for the highest pay. A few other organizations, like Nigam Nutrimed and Ranks Medical, hired students for very low pay.
content.Infrastructure: The canteen portions were available with automatic services to satisfy our needs. In spite of this, manual services were also available in the canteen. The food available in the canteen was acceptable to eat most of the time. The instructions provided by the college were not adjusted according to our convenience. Whether we liked it or not, we had to follow them as they were.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Medical Laboratory Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I will always recommend this college to upcoming students.

content.Placements: Our college provides good knowledge and placements. Placement opportunities are high after graduating from this college.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel and all provide good quality food in our canteen. It has pure vegetarian food only. We have a Wi-Fi facility, a well-equipped laboratory, and classrooms. The library has every minor detail book related to studies. Overall, it's the best.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are so good, well-trained, and well-educated. They always have the capability to teach us and clear our doubts. Semester examinations are a little bit tough, but we can go through studies, and the faculty members will help us. The pass percentage is 40%.

individual_reviews.course: M.Pharma. in Pharmaceutical Analysis - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Good college because of good working environment, good infrastructure, and good placement.

content.Placements: I have completed my course in 2023, 2021-2023 batch. In my course, 15 students were there in the P. Analysis branch, of which 08 students got placed. The highest package was offered by Baxter, which was 5.5 LPA and the lowest package offered was 3 LPA by Micro Lab.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college was good, and they provided sufficient equipment for our research work, like UV, IR, GC, HPLC, DSC, LC-MS, and NMR. All this equipment was sufficient for the research activities in pharmaceutical analysis, and we were free to use it.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: JSS Medical College. An excellent choice.

content.Placements: The internship and placement in our course are amazing, and our college provides many opportunities through connections with various hospitals. The internship experience is excellent and offers exposure to the real world. The top roles offered after our course include medicine, surgery, cardiology, radiology, dermatology, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is decent and labs are well-equipped with the latest technology for better student understanding. The hostel infrastructure is outstanding with multiple types of rooms available for students including both common and attached washroom options. There are Wi-Fi-enabled labs and a library on the college campus. The food facility in the hostel is decent. The medical facilities are available, and there is also a canteen on campus. Many sports facilities are provided for students.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College has good infrastructure and good faculties. This is one of the best colleges for pharmacy.

content.Placements: 90% of students get placement. The highest package is 9 LPA and the lowest is 5 LPA. Dr Reddy's, IncepBio Pvt Ltd. This college has good placements with a good amount of salary, and people here enjoy studying in this college as its NIRF ranking is also 6.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure and good lab facilities, which is used by students of every course to build their practical knowledge. The hostel facility and food are average.
content.Faculty: Our college has qualified and well-educated faculty members. They are very helpful and understand their teaching. Our college good quality of teaching. This course is very good and easy to get jobs. The semester exams in college are good, and 95% of students clear exams. Our college provides more practical knowledge than theoretical knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: No, not like I. I am very proud of my institution and very glad to be a part of it.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, and the food is good. The college atmosphere is good, and the faculty is very good. The classrooms are well-structured, and the labs are good. The library is well-maintained and has a wide collection of books. The college provides free Wi-Fi and has a beautiful basketball court and a large playground.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for life science.
reviews.review_text: The campus for this course or the life Science department is not as big as compared to other departments. The campus provides a small cafeteria with basic savories and beverages. The classrooms are equipped with projectors and screens. The college does not provide a hostel facility. But the area around it provides a wide range of PGs for stay.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Mysore for B.Sc. biochemistry.
reviews.review_text: The canteen food is available at a reasonable cost. The digital library is the best of all. Hostels are amazing. The sports room is the best. The digital library provides free Wi-Fi and usage of computers. Classrooms are spacious and can accommodate multiple students. Each classroom has a smart board for presentation purposes. Each washroom is hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for Bachelor's where you will get a lot of exposure related to studies.
reviews.review_text: There is a hostel for girls which is well maintained along with a bus facility for girls to commute from hostel to the college. The laboratories are well maintained providing a hands on experience which is required for industrial exposure. Classes, library and campus are all well maintained. You will be provided with a full speed wifi access across the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Merit and demerits of joining JSS AHER.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good but can be improved. In my department, there are two labs, one for UG and one for PG. The space is limited and crowded. Though the facilities are decent, there is room for improvement, especially in the lab facilities. I am a day scholar.

reviews.review_heading: Students were getting various placements opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The college's infrastructure is well-maintained and regularly updated. It provides high-quality facilities to its students, with each course having dedicated departments that offer all necessary amenities. Additionally, the college offers hostel accommodations for students.

reviews.review_heading: Useless for life sciences.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities of Wi-Fi, labs, canteen and small coffee shops are there. Canteen has good food with cheap price and a lot of variety to choose from. The college has JSS dental and normal JSS hospital. Sports and hostel facilities are good. Playground and indoor sports complex is there with badminton, basketball, volleyball, table tennis...

reviews.review_heading: It is a well known college of Mysore with good and knowledgeable faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good labs and a library. Wi-Fi is available on campus. Hospital is near the campus. It is a clean campus that has 2 different labs and a Ph.D. room for research scholars.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure .
reviews.review_text: Facility are good but the lab is kind of small but right now they are building new labs and new buildings there is college Wi-Fi which is usually fast and has speed internet there are several libraries and the college also offers extracurricular activities like sports dance and other cultural stuff.

reviews.review_heading: Good worthy for our course, if you are interested join you will have a wonderful time.
reviews.review_text:
The teachers are very friendly, they let us use the labs any time we want to practice. Our college has a seperate building just for this course so it's very spacious, free Wi-Fi, big labs, plenty of classrooms. 
And you have a good library also. Sports we have access to go to any jss in Mysore and play with them. Food is available in every hostel .

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty members but there are no placements.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility is available in our college and good hostel management. There is Wi-Fi available to use in this college and we also have a digital library. Sports facilities are very good and we also have sports days. There is very good ground with good indoor facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It provides excellent infrastructure, faculty members, and other facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this university was excellent. It was a medical college and dental hospital, as well as students, can understand the level of hygiene they maintain. Students also had access to free Wi-Fi on the campus. Students get a medical card that was valid until their course which facilitates free consultation to any medical department...

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied because of the faculty members.

reviews_list.review_title: My college makes me a better person.

review_content.Placements: There are 250 students in my batch. As we are MBBS students, so there are no packages. We have to intern at our college hospitals and then we have to give an NEET PG exam for further studies and then we are paid accordingly. All students must do the internship or else the degree is not provided.
review_content.Infrastructure: Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, Ajmer was built in 1960, so the infrastructure is quite old. But as the saying goes old is gold. Facilities are not so good as the building is old. The food in the hostel mess is nice. Many students have to live outside the campus as the college hostels are old.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, Ajmer is a highly satisfying college.

review_content.Placements: Around 250 students per year are selected for this college through NEET UG exam conducted by NTA. Around Rs. 21,000 stipend is given to internships per year and they hold top roles from the course. Around 99% of students who pass their university exam in their final year are eligible for stipend.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are associated with good quality furniture. Library is open 24 hours with the availability of a strong Wi-fi connection. In boys hostel, there are 5 canteens and mess. Gym with almost all types of machinery. Equipments for sports are provided on demand.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: It's a very good and satisfying college, with huge patient loads in the hospital.

review_content.Placements: In every batch, there are 250 students. And every time, 5 batches are running. After completing MBBS, every student may go for NEET PG exams, medical officer exams, etc. After selecting PG, our college offers around 70000–80000 packages per month, the same in both clinical and non-clinical branches .
review_content.Infrastructure: This time our college infrastructure is not in good condition as it is very old, but new college building is almost ready for the new upcoming batches, along with new hostels. The food quality is very good, no doubt. Every day, every type of food is made. Every week, sports activities occur.

individual_reviews.title: This college is good and has good placement with good infrastructure and faculty.

content.Placements: We have 250 students in each batch and after the final year we appear in NEET PG exam and MO exam which is held after our internship. About 50% of students qualify for these exams. So I want to say that the placement and study course is quite good in our college.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for B.Tech at JSS Academy of Technical Education Noida?
faqs.answer: The admission for B.Tech in JSS Academy of Technical Education Noida has the following procedures. The candidate should have appeared for an entrance exam, JEE Main/ UPCET which is conducted annually for admission into JSS. Then he has to get a valid score and participate in UPTAC counseling for seat allotment before the rank, category, and branch preference (e.g. - 180 seats under Computer Science). Eligibility in this context means there should be at least 45% marks through valid 10+2 in Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry (40% in case of reserved categories). However, there is also an option for direct admission through management quota depending on availability and higher fee structure.

faqs.question: What all courses are offered by JSS Academy of Technical Education Noida?
faqs.answer: JSS Academy of Technical Education Noida, enjoys the privilege of a large variety of courses offered. Undergraduates are offered BTech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and AI & ML. Postgraduate programs include MTech in Manufacturing Systems, MCA, and MBA. Aspiring researchers may also consider PhD programs offered.These fields cover universities in engineering, IT, management, and pharmaceutical sciences, which means they have various career prospects. Although offered by the institute, the courses relating to AKTU guarantee that a cohesive curriculum is attached to the different disciplines making it a diverse and flexible center of education.

faqs.question: Can I get into JSS Noida with 70% in class 12 via JEE Main?
faqs.answer: Yes, with 70% in JEE Main, you can get into JSS Noida. Candidates must score 70% or more marks in the aggregate of the best of five subjects, including Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics, and have a JEE Main Rank (Paper – 1) to be eligible for admission to JSS Noida. Additionally, there are relaxations in minimum marks requirements for different categories like OBC-NCL, SC, ST, differently-abled persons, and defense candidates.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with a green campus and decent hostels, supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are like a green campus and decent hostel including Wi-Fi, a classroom with projectors and a library. The quality of hostel food is moderate not too bad contains four meals and hostels also have medical support 24/7, including outdoor and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Hoping for a better placement rate in JSS, good infrastructure, and focus on skills.
reviews.review_text: For infrastructure, I would say neither is too good like IIT, NIT, IIMs infra, nor too bad like other tier-2 colleges. Hostel infrastructure is better both for boys and girls. Even though the capacity is low and the buildings are old, it is a better place for B.Tech students.

reviews.review_heading: Harsh reality of JSSATE Noida.
reviews.review_text: Labs are not well equipped like a typical government college. Hostels are decent; you will get both AC and non-AC rooms. Mess food is very bad, but I prefer the college hostel at least in the first year. This college is not for you if you love sports and games, no proper facilities are there.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty, good placement and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is overall good. The labs are well. The library has AC, with good environment for studying. The hostel facility is okay. The bathrooms are not well furnished and mostly have construction issues. The food quality is okay, like other mess. The hygiene is properly maintained.

reviews.review_heading: College is good if you can work hard, it can bring you a good amount of opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are above average. The infrastructure for CSE depth of 1st year is not good since there are no AC in classrooms, but some labs are air-conditioned. Wi-Fi speed is average, not up to the mark. The hostel is good, and the mess food is edible till now. The library is top class with good infrastructure, fully air-conditioned, and a wide range of books and newspapers are available.

reviews.review_heading: Ample facilities but infrastructure from inside is much desired.
reviews.review_text: From outside, it looks good, but inside, classes are a little shabby, and roads are well paved, with an abundance of parking spaces. You also get Wi-Fi for all students, great library access, and well-built labs. There are hostels with AC and without AC. The choice is yours and also depends on availability.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, facilities, teachers, and everything.
reviews.review_text: Very good facilities of Wi-Fi, library, classrooms, and labs are available. There are the best hostels ever, with bigger rooms, Wi-Fi connection, and good food. They have 3 shared rooms and a single room, and have AC and non-AC rooms. They provide vegetarian food and snacks. They have a water cooler and a filter also.

reviews.review_heading: A complete review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is what makes it stand above the rest. It has top-notch hostel facilities and good and spacious classrooms. The infrastructure stands at the top of the list. In our hostels, we have both AC hostel (ISH) and non-AC hostel (BH). Both the hostels have quality rooms.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a great infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: On campus, hostels are available, including both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned options. Veg foods are served in the mess, while non-veg foods are not on the menu. Sports facilities are also available on campus, providing great opportunities.

reviews.review_heading: Average college with a good location advantage.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms do not have ACs or even smart boards. Teachers are using old-style blackboards The labs are fine and you can get Wi-Fi access for your laptop. The hostels are good with all the facilities, the mess food is also eatable and on some days, it could be great too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JSS Academy of Technical Education.
reviews.review_text: There is a separate building for every course or department. Every department has its own library, labs, Wi-Fi, halls, and many classrooms. Hostel is good because you have a choice of rooms. You can choose a deluxe hostel room or a simple hostel room. But the food is average. There are many sports. You can play in your hostel as well as in college.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good and no disappointments.
reviews.review_text: There are very nice infrastructure in the college and good libraries are present where we get the articles to read nice books for pharmacy are provided. Sports events are done per year. The food canteen is very good with good hostel facilities and good mess food.

reviews.review_heading: College is overall good if you are a brilliant, but not for below-average students
reviews.review_text: Everything was good, but classrooms are not fully equipped as AC is not provided by the college. The library is good, and there is a motivating environment for study. Sports and canteen facilities are available, but medical facilities are not. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and there is an auditorium and transport services available.

reviews.review_heading: JSS’s honest truth with all its upsides and downsides, so don’t miss it.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms aren’t air-conditioned and are really suffocating in the summer. But the library is fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi is okay. The girls’ hostel is really good; it has both AC and non-AC rooms, the food is good and hygienic, and there are sports facilities. The labs have AC and are well-equipped.

reviews.review_heading: JSS, Noida is still relevant in 2025.
reviews.review_text: Hostel food is below average and quality degrades in night food. Hostel life is good, with sufficient campus area for any sports. There are school-like classrooms with no AC and coolers, classes become bad in the summers, and decent infrastructure still needs improvement.

review_summary.college_name: Shri Shankaracharya Technical Campus Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Integrated BCA+ MCA - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good college which has all good quality which is required for any graduation course.

content.Placements: Minimum and average students are placed in my course. Students who pursue different subjects like bio, commerce, and arts are also placed in the same way. The highest package offered is 8.5 LPA, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA. Top recruitment is there in Reliance, Nilon, and many others.
content.Infrastructure: There are computer labs, science labs, and a library for various experiments and educational purposes. Medical facilities are also provided at Shankaracharya Hospital. Sports and playgrounds are also good. A canteen is provided for lunch. Students who are interested in sports can play wherever they want.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college is decent, with supportive faculty and departments. It is value for money.

content.Placements: There are placements, but they are not up to the mark when compared to the total number of students graduated. Faculty members promise 100 percent placement when you take admission into this college, but providing placement to even 200 graduates out of 1000 cannot be called 100% placement.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are decent. There is a separate hostel for freshers and another for seniors, so there is no ragging in this college. You share a room with 2-3 people in the first year, and from the second year, 2 people occupy one room. However, most students shift outside the campus to PGs, flats, etc., after the first year.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I will not recommend this college as it is now overcrowded for B.Pharmacy.

content.Placements: Nearly 10-20% students are placed through campus drives. Salary packages range from 2 LPA to 5 LPA. Top recruiter is 3M. Around 50% of students get internships in pharma companies for roles such as sales, production, QA, and research. It has scope for more companies.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are spacious, but mostly simple seating, like benches/desks. It also equipped with blackboards/whiteboards, sometimes a projector. Basic ventilation and fans, and AC are limited to seminar halls only. There are different labs for different subjects. There is one life really sufficient for B.Pharmacy. Students have no access to Wi-Fi. I haven't lived in hostel but I have listened to different students who say that hostel food is the worst. There is no specific sports and games period, we only get to play when there is a festival or different pharmacy days.

reviews.review_heading: Dents to come to the college .

reviews_list.review_title: Beautiful campus hosting a lot of events, good faculty, and nice patient load.

review_content.Placements: As this is a medical course, graduation students either go for higher education or open their own clinics. Hospitals do not come for placements. An internship is a part of the course and is unpaid but as the patient load is quite good, you get to learn a lot of procedures.
review_content.Infrastructure: An extremely beautiful campus is there. Lush green and very clear too. Wi-Fi and AC are available in lecture halls and there is an AC library with a huge collection of books. Comfortable hostels and good food in the mess. 3 canteens with very good food and hygienic too. Dental labs are available, which are clean and spacious. The hospital is also well maintained.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Really good infrastructure and facilities with good hospital as well.

review_content.Placements: When I got admission, 100 students were there with me. The placement in the medical field is worth less because, in the medical dental field, no one can do a job for more than 2 years. This is a clinic-based programme. And in college, no such placement is there. All passout dentists can practice in any private hospital for a very decent salary.
review_content.Infrastructure: The best dental college in Gujarat has such a well-known infrastructure. The campus is full of clean, big grounds as well as separate indoor play grounds. The classroom is fully equipped with a projector and AC. The library is the best because all required textbooks, reference book and journals are available, so there is no need to buy a new one. Hostels are also available on campus. Medical staff is available in clinics all the time.

faqs.question: How do I get admission to Karnavati School of Dentistry?

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities with good hospital as well.

Hostels are also available on campus. Medical staff is available in clinics all the time.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Karnavati School of Dentistry, Karnavati University.

The same can not be stated about canteen and food though.

reviews.review_heading: This is the college of your dreams.

review_summary.college_name: DY Patil University Pune Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Excellent and beautiful campus, with the best facilities. Placement needs improvement.

content.Placements: 65% of students are placed during the latest placement season. The recruiting companies are Adobe, Atlassian, TCS, Infosys, Deloitte, Amazon, Microsoft, and Google. The average package is 12.2 LPA. The top roles offered are software development, data science intern, machine learning intern, and web development intern.
content.Infrastructure: The department has well-equipped labs specific to the course, such as regular lab upgrades are done based on industry needs. There are ML, IoT, Robotics, and Embedded Systems labs, with high-performance systems and licensed software. The college hostel rooms are good, and it is a beautiful campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The campus is awesome, and the faculty is good, but the only thing is that placement is not good.

content.Placements: In my college, out of 600 students, only 50-60 students get placements. The students who have a 9+ CGPA have been placed. The highest package is 12 LPA and the lowest is 2.5 LPA. The roles offered by the course are Developer, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, ML Engineer, etc. Up to 90% have gotten an internship on the Edu Skills platform.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is the best. Entire campus have Wi-Fi networks, and labs are the best. Classrooms are also the best, and the library is average. The hostel is the best, but it is very costly. The quality of food available in the mess is good, and medical facilities are average. In sports, the university has a separate academy. The university's cricket ground hosts leagues like the Vijay Trophy, DY Patil Trophy, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college is nicely maintained, but it can also be more upgraded in various fields.

content.Placements: The college has average placement and offers. The Corporate Relations and Career Services Cell, i.e., the T and P Cell, works hard to bring companies to the campus. They try to bring in more start-up companies, which makes it easier for students to get placed. The average placement CTC offered is 6–7 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure provided to students is quite good. Our college has multiple labs set up for students to study, which helps them grow their skills and gain experience in their particular domain. The hostel facilities are also available for students, located near the college only.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Graphic Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The campus is so peaceful.

content.Placements: I am a B.Des. in Graphic Design first-year student from D Y Patil University, Pune. There is no specific package to tell. It is all based on our skills, how we create it, and gain knowledge from it. Companies will hire us on the basis of our skills.
content.Infrastructure: The college has facilities like Wi-Fi, a good ambience, and tables according to our department, which are comfortable, so we can work properly. The hostel has Wi-Fi and a mess facility. The food in our mess is good. We do have other food items.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Graphic Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I love the campus, and it has the greenery.

content.Placements: I am a first-year B.Des student at DY Patil University. Placements are always based on our skills, but the college provides a lot of guidance to us. They offer plenty of skills and resources, so by the last year, we are fully prepared for placements with skills.
content.Infrastructure: The college is nice. We have a library, computer lab, and a workshop for working on models. The classrooms are well infrastructure, and the tables are according to the work, so they are comfortable. Both the hostel and the college have Wi-Fi. The food is good.

admission_process.title: DY Patil University Pune Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: DY Patil University Pune admissionsare primarilyentrance-based. The university accepts national or state-level entrance exams such as NATA,MHT-CET, CMAT, MAH CET, etc. for admission to specific courses. The university also conductsDYPCETfor admission to some of the courses such asBBA, MBA, etc. DYPU Pune offers a wide range of UG, PG, and doctoral programmes to students acrossEngineering, Management, and Science, among others.DY Patil Puneoffers courses through seven schools. Interested candidates can apply online on the official website of the university.

DY Patil University Pune is currently accepting applications for all courses. All the programmes are offered in full-time mode at UG, PG and doctoral levels. Below are keyDY Patil Pune admissionhighlights:

DY Patil Pune admission 2025is based on entrance exam scores for most of the courses. Candidates also need to fulfil course-specific eligibility to apply for a course in DYPU. Given below is the list of some of the popularDY Patil Pune coursesalong with their selection and eligibility criteria:

All the candidates seeking admission to DYPU, need to appear in an entrance test to secure a seat in their desired course. The seat intake varies depending on the programme. Programmes such as BArch have a very limited intake while a large number of students can be admitted to the BTech programme at DY Patil University. The table below shows the number of seats available for some of the courses at DY Patil University:
Note: Candidates must note that this information is sourced from the official website of the institute/university-sanctioning body and is subject to change.

The university offers admission both on an entrance and merit basis. Candidates have to get through all the selection rounds of the respective course to get a seat. The admission process involves application form filling and a selection process followed by counselling or an interview (for some courses). Below is the step-wiseDY Patil University Pune admission process:
STEP 1: DY Patil Pune Application Process 2025

The DY Patil Pune application process is carried out in online mode. Thus, aspirants can apply by visiting the official website of the university. The application process involves online registration, form filling, document upload, and fee payment. Candidates need to pay an application fee ofINR 800for UG and diploma courses. The application fee for PG programmes isINR 1,000.
STEP 2: Selection Process

DY Patil Pune accepts entrance exam scores for admission to most of the courses. The university accepts MHT CET, JEE Main, UCEED, NEET, etc. for admission to specific programmes. For UG, the candidates also need to qualify for Class 12. For PG courses, graduation in the relevant discipline is required. Candidates with the minimum qualifications will be eligible for admission. For the MBA, the university also calls candidates for the Written Ability Test and PI round.
STEP 3: Fee Payment & Admission Confirmation

The university releases a course-wise merit list on the official website of DY Patil Pune. Candidates who make it to the final selection list or are selected after counselling can pay the required amount of fee to confirm their seat. Also, the selected candidates have to submit specified documents for verification.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent and beautiful campus, with the best facilities. Placement needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-equipped labs specific to the course, such as regular lab upgrades are done based on industry needs. There are ML, IoT, Robotics, and Embedded Systems labs, with high-performance systems and licensed software.  The college hostel rooms are good, and it is a beautiful campus.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is awesome, and the faculty is good, but the only thing is that placement is not good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the best. Entire campus  have Wi-Fi networks, and labs are the best. Classrooms are also the best, and the library is average. The hostel is the best, but it is very costly. The quality of food available in the mess is good, and medical facilities are average. In sports, the university has a separate academy. The university's cricket ground hosts leagues like the Vijay Trophy, DY Patil Trophy, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The college is nicely maintained, but it can also be more upgraded in various fields.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided to students is quite good. Our college has multiple labs set up for students to study, which helps them grow their skills and gain experience in their particular domain. The hostel facilities are also available for students, located near the college only.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is so peaceful.
reviews.review_text: The college has facilities like Wi-Fi, a good ambience, and tables according to our department, which are comfortable, so we can work properly. The hostel has Wi-Fi and a mess facility. The food in our mess is good. We do have other food items.

reviews.review_heading: I love the campus, and it has the greenery.
reviews.review_text: The college is nice. We have a library, computer lab, and a workshop for working on models. The classrooms are well infrastructure, and the tables are according to the work, so they are comfortable. Both the hostel and the college have Wi-Fi. The food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Worth the Money and Average Placements.
reviews.review_text: Now, this is the good part, the hostel is good, and the mess facilities are decent at best. The workshop has all the basic equipment, but items used, like wood and thermocol, have to be supplied by students themselves, along with the additional cost and travel and arranging transport to bring them to the college workshop.

reviews.review_heading: A single floor college.
reviews.review_text: Food in canteen is decent, a bit pricey but okay. The hostel is strict and doesn't allow students to go out after 7:00 PM, forcing students to use canteen food for dinner that way. The area around the hostel is bad, crime rates are at the highest, and transport issues are there as it's in the middle of nowhere.

reviews.review_heading: Review for D. Y Patil University, Ambi, Pune.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi services are available full-time, and electricity backup is also there along with an abundant water supply. The hostel has three types of rooms single, double, and triple. Water coolers are placed on every floor in each building. Washing machines are available in hostels. There are two types of hostels old and new.

reviews.review_heading: If you have no option left and you think that you can study on your own. But, just need a degree.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure, there's no doubt they have massive buildings. There are a total of 5 buildings, and all are above 7 floors. Classrooms are pretty huge, and they have a professional cricket ground. However, they lack auditoriums. The one we have is super small.

reviews.review_heading: I am not so satisfied with faculty members, and placements are not there.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and campus are pretty good and well-maintained. Wi-Fi facility is available, and there is a library and canteen are available. The infrastructure for the course is decent, not good, but there are huge spacious classrooms with proper ventilation and sunlight. However, desks are not good, and the seating is not proper. There is no proper management, no computer labs, and no proper facilities. However, the college has a cricket stadium, which is one of the biggest.

reviews.review_heading: Dr. D. Y. Patil College, Pune - Good campus and teachers, strong industry tries.
reviews.review_text: I like the atmosphere of our college because of the greenery and refreshing air with multiple buildings and spacious too. Lack of faculty members according to the fees we pay for our college. Management is not good and should take initiatives properly and responsibly. I hope they take our feedback properly also and are properly maintained. We take a lot of effort to complete it with sleepless nights. But still, our assignments are not given that much value for the efforts we have made, thank you...

reviews.review_heading: A transformative college experience with strong academic and professional campus life.
reviews.review_text: Departments are offered well-equipped design studio, CAD labs, model making workshop, high-speed Wi-Fi, good library, and smart classroom. The library is stocked with design journals, books, and resources. Hostel facilities are clean, secure, and comfortable offering a peaceful environment for students. The mess provides hygienic food with decent variety. The canteen provides additional snacks. Medical facilities are provided on campus. Sports facilities are provided for both indoor and outdoor ...

reviews.review_heading: A transformative college experience with strong academics and vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facilities are provided. Hostel is well maintained, but has a few restrictions. Canteen food is pretty good. Sports and games I am not really interested.

reviews.review_heading: Recommendations for a good architecture college.
reviews.review_text: New hostel block is completely good with all sorts of modern equipments. The cleaning and maintenance of the hostel is done well. There are options to choose from single, double, and triple sharing rooms. Wi-Fi and laundry facilities are also available at the hostel here.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and campus worth it.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities like well-equipped Wi-Fi, library, many sports events keep happening, with good cricket ground, basketball court, football, and volleyball also. It has good canteen services with hygienic food. Good toilets are there. The campus is always clean.

review_summary.college_name: School of Health Sciences Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college and its infrastructure. Many fests are also held here.

content.Placements: Mostly 80-90% of students get placement, and it totally depends on students how they study. The college provides every single student with internships in many hospitals and like by the college. Students get placed in Max, Paras, and Maringo, which is best in Gurgaon with the role of radiographer technician.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is provided to students. There are sports area and three facilities for education buildings. Classrooms are good, and the library has every type of book. The hostel is good but a little expensive. It provides good food and facilities for sports. The building is also good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Qualities of Sushant University.

content.Placements: 5–6 students out of a batch of 37 got placement in Tata Mg Company. Other students also have some interviews to do. Some of them qualified for the interview, while others could not make it. Other than this, they also prepared a board to show the students scores.
content.Infrastructure: Sushant University has three libraries: one is common for all courses, the other is for the architecture department and the last one is for the law department. It also has a big canteen, including various cafeterias where you can enjoy any food you like.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is not the best college for pharmacy.

content.Placements: Not much greater companies are involved in the placements as previously shown that the companies from outside visit here for recruitment. Many top companies visit our college for placements because the owner has been changed.
content.Infrastructure: This college does not have proper classrooms for the B.Pharma students. There are many problems in this college. They also scold us for late entry. Hotels are not good.
content.Faculty: Many faculty members are freshers. They like only to read books in front of students. If we ask doubts, they will answer them tomorrow. They do not know how to solve students' doubts.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc.(Hons.) in Psychology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Our college is decent for students.

content.Placements: Almost 91% of students got placed in our course. Internships are also offered in this college. After completing this degree, we can opt for basic jobs at psychiatric or psychological clinics with decent salary packages.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi facility is not available. Computer laboratory, library, canteens, basketball court, badminton court, table tennis court, cricket pitches, and basketball court are available in this college. The food served in the canteen is average at affordable prices. Our campus location is very good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Optometry (B.Optom) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: SU will give you or I should say you'll have to take whatever you need for a good career.

content.Placements: The placements, especially for a profession like optometry, aren't a problem because of the higher demand of talented practitioners because optometry is still a newer and growing profession. SU has tie-ups with several hospitals like Arunodaya Deseret Eye hospital and Manthan where since this year we go for weekly placements right from our 2nd year. I have also seen my seniors getting placed in these hospitals.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure especially for the Health Science building is compromised. But it isn't that bad because all others buildings like hotel management and engineering are well maintained and are open for all students no matter what course. Air-conditioners stop working at times for the health science department. After several applications and reminders, they will send a technician just to satisfy you but the air-conditioners still won't work. The administration is weak.

admission_process.title: School of Nursing and Health Sciences NIU Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: School of Nursing and Health Sciences admission 2025is primarily entrance-based. Also known asSNHS-NIU, it is one of the 11 constituent units ofNoida International University (NIU)founded byMaruti Educational Trust. The School was established in 2011 and has been recognised by the State Medical Faculty, Uttar Pradesh (SMF), the Indian Nursing Council (INC) and the Indian Association of Physiotherapists (IAP). School of Nursing and Health Sciences Noida International University upskills several nurses, therapists and technicians to work in a variety of settings, including the hospital, community, business sector, home healthcare, sports and laboratories. The School offers education in streams such as Nursing, Medical, Physiotherapy, Paramedical and Public Health at UG and PG level. Additionally, the School also offers a diploma in various Nursing and Paramedical streams to Medical aspirants looking for short-term programmes.

SNHS NIU course admsisionis subject to the admission criteria decided by the college and concerning authority. Students must satisfy the criteria to get a seat at the institute for the desired programame. School of Nursing and Health Sciences Noida International University application process is conducted in both online and offline modes. Admission to all UG and PG programmes is based on Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) conducted by the University. The application process begins in the month ofMayevery year for Paramedical and Nursing programmes. faqs.question: Can I apply for NIC BSc courses in offline mode?
faqs.answer: No, candidates cannot apply for NIC BSc admissions in offline mode. Candidates need to apply for CUET exam in order to qualify for admissions into BSc at NIC. Candidates will need to visit the official website of NIC to apply for the CUET entrance exam.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in NIU for BSc with 60% in Class 12th?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidate who have secured 60% in Class 12 board exams can secure an admission into BSc courses offered by the NIU. The candidates must clear Class 12 in the PCB stream to be eligible for most BSc courses and then appear for the CUET entrance exam to qualify for admissions. The NIU BSc admissions are decided through the CUET entrance exam.

faqs.question: Are admissions into BSc courses at NIU still open in 2025?
faqs.answer: No, the BSc course admissions at NIU are no longer open in 2025. The BSc admissions at NIU are decided by the scores obtained by a candidate in the CUET entrance exams. The last date to register for the CUET exam ended in the month of March in 2025. The exam has already been concluded in the month of July. Candidates need to wait for the announcement of the CUET 2026 exam for BSc admissions at NIU.

faqs.question: Can I take admission in NIU BSc without CUET?
faqs.answer: No, all candidates who wish to get admissions into the NIU BSc courses are required to clear the CUET exam. The admissions into NIU BSc courses are decided by a candidate's performance in the CUET exam. The CUET exam for the year 2025 has already passed. Hence, candidates are required to wait for CUET 2026 which will be announced very soon.

University also has it's parental hospital which gives a better experience of practical things to students. Administration department is also very supportive. Smart classes are there at university. Labs for different subjects are also available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: The college is great, with great infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college has very beautiful infrastructure. Our college also has a big library with almost every book possible. The college has tie-ups with the hostel, and the hostel facilities are also very nice. The food quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my college and course.
reviews.review_text: All Facilities are provided in our college and the infrastructure of our college is very good and beautiful. The quality of facilities and food in the hostel is very good the mess and canteens are available in the college. A hostel and all medical and sports facilities are provided. A supportive community with exceptional faculty where academic rigor meets real-world opportunity propelling students to achieve their full potential.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college and faculty and with good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure will be absolutely awesome, and the maintenance will be better. Facilities are also qualified and well explained. Wi-Fi will be good; it will also have labs, a library, and so many blocks and classrooms for their own perspective courses.

reviews.review_heading: College is good for student's personal development.
reviews.review_text:
The college is NACC A+. 
We have infrastructure also available in my course, which has big digital classrooms and has 3 big libraries. 
We have so many facilities. We have 3 times to eat tiffin, lunch, and dinner and also provide snacks. 
We have a canteen to buy anything we have in our own hospital, NIMS. 
We have a big 10-acre playground.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college to study.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. It consists of several blocks, 5 canteens, and a hospital. Students can practice in the hospital. All the facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, and a library are available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: The placements are not good, and the campus crowd is low.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is available. The library doesn't always have many books. Only limited books are available. The hostel food is of very bad quality. The faculty members don't take regular classes, and the lab sessions are not held.

reviews.review_heading: God forbid the university is very nice wow facilities and faculty members too good very good.
reviews.review_text: I'm not living in hostel so I can't say anything about it but if we talk about our university, it's pretty the infrastructure is best and also, there are 4-5cafes you can explore, you can go sit in library it's very decent and peaceful in there, university is 10/10.

reviews.review_heading: Not good this college for GNM course.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure, but faculty is not so much satisfying, do net take admission in this college, college life is good only for enjoyment purpose not for studying purpose because they don't give you better practical knowledge if you told college incharge to refund your money they talk to you in rude behavior.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied college because of faculty and most importantly infrastructure .
reviews.review_text:
The most loving and attractive thing in campus is infrastructure itself. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus 
Sitting arrangements in classroom is comfortable 
Library itself in the campus is very huge and almost every that you need will be easily available there. Overall my experience is good?

reviews.review_heading: Better college with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text:
Excellent infrastructure we have with well furnished classrooms and benches. We had an ground. Wi-Fi facility. The facility of Wi-Fi is all around the campus there is no signal issue. Library facility:we found maximum books from it. Furnitured classes
 Ground .

reviews.review_heading: The happy place, education at its best with ease and comfort.
reviews.review_text: Departments are having sufficient equipment, modalities along with the intellect professionals, the lecturers. Other facilities like the library, auditorium and the most important cafeteria are also present. They are all maintained nicely by the institute as well as the students. All in all amazing atmosphere to be in.

reviews.review_heading: College infrastructure is good, campus life is great, great choice for medical students.
reviews.review_text:
The college infrastructure is very nice; it has received great compliments from the inspection squad, and the college got NAAC A grade. The library is large with a comfortable sitting area. Classrooms are good, well-fitted for class strength, and each class has a projector. Wi-Fi is always available, easily accessible, and fast.
Labs are available for our course but they don’t show much interest in conducting lab sessions. Hostel facilities are nice, rooms are comfortable, and food is okay somet...
